name: What are the common methods for slab leak repair?

mainEntity.name: What are the common methods for slab leak repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several methods for repairing a slab leak, depending on its severity and location. The most common include spot repair, where the concrete slab is opened directly above the leak for a localized fix. Another option is re-piping or re-routing, which involves bypassing the damaged section of pipe entirely and running a new line through the walls or attic. Pipe lining, where a new epoxy liner is inserted into the existing pipe, is also an option for certain types of leaks. The best method depends on your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Slab leak repair methods include spot repair, re-piping, or pipe lining, chosen based on leak location and severity.
